new_value: Accepted: broadside intentionally serves a subset of read-only routes. Shelf endpoints require user context (no auth in broadside). Funkwhale playlist_tracks/channel/podcast/listen need content that broadside doesn't host. The read_only_paths() function documents the full contract; broadside implements what makes sense for broadcast-only.
